schema.description: A page or app authored in App Studio, shown in the menu of the sites it names (the Portal, Cohort or both). kind=page is HTML+CSS with live-data tags and behaviours (no script); kind=app is a self-contained web app run in a sandboxed iframe. Only status=published records are served.

slug.description: URL segment under /pages/ on each site. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

summary.description: One or two sentences for listings.

source.description: The page or app source as written in App Studio.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last save.

sites.description: The sites whose menu shows the page, comma separated: portal, cohort. A page without it is a Portal page.

lang.description: The page's language, e.g. en or ar; empty for every language. A site shows the pages in its visitor's language.

menu_position.description: Its place in the menu, lower first; pages without one follow, by title.
